title: Shortest Distance to Target String in a Circular Array
summary: Given a circular array of strings words and a target string, find the shortest distance to the target from a starting index.
statement: Given a circular array of strings words and a target string, find the shortest distance to the target from a starting index. If the target is not in words, return -1. The array wraps around, and you can move to the next or previous word with one step.
constraints: Moving one step left or right costs one and indexes wrap around.
Return the fewest steps from startIndex to any occurrence of target.
Return -1 when target does not occur.
hints: For an occurrence at index i, clockwise distance is (i-start)%n and counterclockwise distance is (start-i)%n.
Take the smaller directional distance for each occurrence.
Minimize across all matching indexes; return -1 if none match.
The two directions are the only simple routes on a cycle, so their minimum is the shortest path to each occurrence.
editorial: The two directions are the only simple routes on a cycle, so their minimum is the shortest path to each occurrence.

tests.explanation: The occurrence at index zero is one left step from start index one.
The target is absent, so the result is minus one.
